_meta.rationale: Stripe's first-preference display face Sohne maps to Inter in BRAND_FONT_REGISTRY (key 'sohne'). The library renders the free alternative; the disclosure aside surfaces both names. No palette or spacing assertions; those would require a source-of-truth not yet documented for buttons.

assertions.evaluate: (() => { const el = document.querySelector('.a-button'); if (!el) return false; const fam = window.getComputedStyle(el).fontFamily || ''; return fam.toLowerCase().includes('inter'); })()
(() => { const el = document.querySelector('.a-button'); if (!el) return false; return (el.textContent || '').toLowerCase().includes('stripe'); })()
